name: Artist
overview: Scripture reveals God as the ultimate Artist, who created the heavens and the earth by His sovereign power (Genesis 1:1). He endows gifted individuals, like Aholiab, with wisdom and skill to carry out His commands, demonstrating that artistic ability is a divine gift (Exodus 31:6). The Spirit of God fills craftsmen with understanding and knowledge for their workmanship, showing that true artistry flows from God's enabling presence (Exodus 35:31). The natural world itself proclaims God's glory as His handiwork, reflecting His creative excellence and intentional design (Psalms 19:1).
